//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type commandEligibilityClock struct{}

func (commandEligibilityClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

// Uses already-migrated isolated PostgreSQL; starts/migrates/resets nothing.
func TestCommandEligibilityPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("COMMAND_ELIGIBILITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("set COMMAND_ELIGIBILITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL to migrated loopback *_integration_proof")
	}
	cfg, e := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if (cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" && cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "localhost" && cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "::1") || !strings.HasSuffix(cfg.ConnConfig.Database, "_integration_proof") {
		t.Fatal("requires isolated loopback *_integration_proof")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, e := pgxpool.New(ctx, dsn)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if e = pool.Ping(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	newPath := func(t *testing.T, actor, kind string, two bool) domain.StudentLearningPath {
		t.Helper()
		if actor == "" {
			actor = uuid.NewString()
		}
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		p := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: actor, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "eligibility-r1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Command eligibility fixture", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
		count := 1
		if two {
			count = 2
		}
		for n := 0; n < count; n++ {
			r := domain.LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: kind, Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString(), RevisionID: uuid.NewString()}}
			if kind == "practice_completed" {
				r.SourceReference.ID = r.SourceReference.RevisionID
			}
			status := domain.LearningPathItemReady
			if n > 0 {
				status = domain.LearningPathItemPlanned
			}
			p.Items = append(p.Items, domain.LearningPathItem{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: n, Status: status, ReasonCode: "fixture", LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"frozen"}`), FrozenRequirements: []domain.LessonRequirement{r}, Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}})
		}
		if kind == "standalone" {
			for n := range p.Items {
				p.Items[n].ReferenceType = "practice"
				p.Items[n].ReferenceID = uuid.NewString()
				p.Items[n].LessonRevisionID = ""
				p.Items[n].LessonContent = nil
				p.Items[n].FrozenRequirements = nil
			}
		}
		p, _, e := journey.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, p, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		return p
	}
	reserveInput := func(t *testing.T, p domain.StudentLearningPath, i domain.LearningPathItem, actor string) domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve {
		t.Helper()
		r := domain.LessonRequirement{}
		itemID, requirementID := "", ""
		if i.ReferenceType == "practice" {
			r.SourceReference.RevisionID = i.ReferenceID
		} else {
			r = i.FrozenRequirements[0]
			itemID = i.ID
			requirementID = r.ID
		}
		id := uuid.NewString()
		input, e := domain.NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema, StudentID: actor, TaskInstanceID: id, TaskRevisionID: r.SourceReference.RevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: i.Targets, LearningPathID: p.ID, LearningPathItemID: itemID, RequirementID: requirementID, IdempotencyKey: id, LearningActionID: uuid.NewString(), OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC()})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		return input
	}
	invoke := func(t *testing.T, p domain.StudentLearningPath, i domain.LearningPathItem, actor string) error {
		t.Helper()
		if i.ReferenceType == "practice" {
			_, _, e := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, reserveInput(t, p, i, actor))
			return e
		}
		r := i.FrozenRequirements[0]
		if r.Type == "theory_acknowledged" {
			_, e := (student.LessonCompletion{Repository: journey, Clock: commandEligibilityClock{}}).AcknowledgeTheory(ctx, actor, i.ID, r.ID, uuid.NewString())
			return e
		}
		if r.Type == "practice_completed" {
			_, _, e := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, reserveInput(t, p, i, actor))
			return e
		}
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		frozen, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"id": r.SourceReference.ID, "_completion_fact_type": r.Type, "_completion_source_revision_id": r.SourceReference.RevisionID})
		answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: actor, TaskID: r.SourceReference.ID, LearningPathItemID: i.ID, RequirementID: r.ID, FrozenTaskJSON: frozen, Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress, StartedAt: now, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
		action, e := domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID, StudentID: actor, TaskID: answer.TaskID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLessonTask, ContextID: answer.TaskID, LearningTargets: i.Targets, EvidenceClass: domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, OpenedAt: now})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		_, _, e = actions.CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, nil, action)
		return e
	}
	snapshot := func(t *testing.T, p domain.StudentLearningPath) string {
		t.Helper()
		state, e := journey.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		var counts []int
		for _, table := range []string{"student_lesson_activity_fact", "student_task_answer", "student_learning_action", "student_learning_path_command"} {
			var c int
			if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count(*) FROM "+table+" WHERE student_id=$1", p.StudentID).Scan(&c); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			counts = append(counts, c)
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
			State  domain.LearningPathPlanningState
			Counts []int
		}{state, counts})
		return string(b)
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"theory_acknowledged", "quiz_passed", "task_passed", "practice_completed", "standalone"} {
		for _, mode := range []string{"future", "paused", "unselected", "foreign", "satisfied"} {
			if kind == "standalone" && mode == "satisfied" {
				continue
			}
			t.Run(kind+"/"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
				p := newPath(t, "", kind, mode == "future")
				i := p.Items[0]
				actor := p.StudentID
				if mode == "future" {
					i = p.Items[1]
				}
				if mode == "paused" {
					c, e := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, actor)
					if e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					if _, e = journey.PauseLearningPath(ctx, actor, p.ID, c.Version, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
				}
				if mode == "unselected" {
					other := newPath(t, actor, "theory_acknowledged", false)
					c, e := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, actor)
					if e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					if _, e = journey.ActivateLearningPath(ctx, actor, other.ID, c.Version, false, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
				}
				if mode == "foreign" {
					actor = uuid.NewString()
				}
				if mode == "satisfied" {
					reqs := append([]domain.LessonRequirement(nil), i.FrozenRequirements...)
					reqs[0].Satisfied = true
					raw, _ := json.Marshal(reqs)
					if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path_item SET frozen_requirements=$2 WHERE id=$1`, i.ID, raw); e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
				}
				before := snapshot(t, p)
				e := invoke(t, p, i, actor)
				if !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) && !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrNotFound) && !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrInvalidStatus) {
					t.Fatalf("ineligible command accepted mode=%s kind=%s error=%v", mode, kind, e)
				}
				if after := snapshot(t, p); before != after {
					t.Fatal("denial mutated state/counters")
				}
			})
		}
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"quiz_passed", "task_passed"} {
		t.Run("current_valid_and_late_passed/"+kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			p := newPath(t, "", kind, false)
			i := p.Items[0]
			// Optional activity and other requirement presentation priorities are
			// not admission prerequisites within the current item.
			reqs := append([]domain.LessonRequirement(nil), i.FrozenRequirements...)
			reqs = append(reqs, domain.LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: false, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString()}})
			raw, _ := json.Marshal(reqs)
			if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_learning_path_item SET frozen_requirements=$2 WHERE id=$1`, i.ID, raw); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if e = invoke(t, p, i, p.StudentID); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("eligible current command denied: %v", e)
			}
			var answerID string
			if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id::text FROM student_task_answer WHERE student_id=$1`, p.StudentID).Scan(&answerID); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			answer, e := (postgres.StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG{Pool: pool}).GetByID(ctx, answerID)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			action, e := actions.GetActiveByAnswer(ctx, answerID)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if kind == "quiz_passed" {
				c, _ := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
				if _, e = journey.PauseLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID, c.Version, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			} else {
				other := newPath(t, p.StudentID, "theory_acknowledged", false)
				c, _ := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
				if _, e = journey.ActivateLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, other.ID, c.Version, false, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			}
			closed := time.Now().UTC()
			event, e := domain.NewLearningActionClosedEvent(uuid.NewString(), action, closed)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			action.Outcome = domain.LearningActionPassed
			action.OutcomePolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
			answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed
			answer.EndedAt = &closed
			answer.UpdatedAt = closed
			if e = actions.CloseAnswer(ctx, *answer, action, event); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("valid late outcome rejected: %v", e)
			}
			item, e := journey.GetLessonItem(ctx, p.StudentID, i.ID)
			if e != nil || item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted || !item.FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied || item.FrozenRequirements[1].Satisfied {
				t.Fatalf("late result/optional reducer: %+v err=%v", item, e)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"practice_completed", "standalone"} {
		t.Run("current_practice_open_replay_and_late_evidence/"+kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			p := newPath(t, "", kind, false)
			input := reserveInput(t, p, p.Items[0], p.StudentID)
			b, _, e := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, input)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			opened, replayed, e := actions.OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx, p.StudentID, b.TaskInstanceID, b.LearningActionID, time.Now().UTC())
			if e != nil || replayed {
				t.Fatalf("eligible open: %v", e)
			}
			c, _ := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
			if _, e = journey.PauseLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID, c.Version, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			before := snapshot(t, p)
			again, replayed, e := actions.OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx, p.StudentID, b.TaskInstanceID, b.LearningActionID, time.Now().UTC())
			if e != nil || !replayed || !reflect.DeepEqual(opened, again) {
				t.Fatalf("OPEN replay denied: %v", e)
			}
			if before != snapshot(t, p) {
				t.Fatal("OPEN replay mutated state")
			}
			id := uuid.NewString()
			now := time.Now().UTC()
			evidence := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2, EvidenceID: id, SubmissionID: id, LearningActionID: b.LearningActionID, StudentID: p.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: b.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: b.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: b.TaskRevisionDigest, WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), LearningPathItemID: b.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: b.RequirementID, Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2, Evidence: []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: input.LearningTargets[0], Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 0.9, StepIDs: []string{"implement"}}}, OccurredAt: now}
			evidence, e = domain.NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(p.StudentID, b.TaskInstanceID, id, evidence)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			changed, e := actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, evidence, now)
			if e != nil || !changed {
				t.Fatalf("late real Practice evidence denied: changed=%v err=%v", changed, e)
			}
			state, e := journey.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID)
			if e != nil || state.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
				t.Fatalf("late Practice item not completed: %+v err=%v", state, e)
			}
			if changed, e = actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, evidence, now); e != nil || changed {
				t.Fatalf("evidence replay changed: %v", e)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("theory_exact_replay_after_pause_and_pure_read", func(t *testing.T) {
		p := newPath(t, "", "theory_acknowledged", false)
		i := p.Items[0]
		r := i.FrozenRequirements[0]
		key := uuid.NewString()
		uc := student.LessonCompletion{Repository: journey, Clock: commandEligibilityClock{}}
		accepted, e := uc.AcknowledgeTheory(ctx, p.StudentID, i.ID, r.ID, key)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		c, e := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if _, e = journey.PauseLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID, c.Version, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		before := snapshot(t, p)
		replay, e := uc.AcknowledgeTheory(ctx, p.StudentID, i.ID, r.ID, key)
		if e != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(accepted, replay) {
			t.Fatalf("exact accepted replay lost: %v", e)
		}
		if _, e = journey.GetLessonItem(ctx, p.StudentID, i.ID); e != nil {
			t.Fatal("pure content read should remain available")
		}
		if before != snapshot(t, p) {
			t.Fatal("replay/read mutated state")
		}
	})
	for _, mode := range []string{"paused", "unselected"} {
		t.Run("reserved_embedded_open/"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			p := newPath(t, "", "practice_completed", false)
			input := reserveInput(t, p, p.Items[0], p.StudentID)
			b, _, e := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, input)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if mode == "paused" {
				c, _ := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
				if _, e = journey.PauseLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, p.ID, c.Version, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			} else {
				other := newPath(t, p.StudentID, "theory_acknowledged", false)
				c, _ := journey.GetLearningContext(ctx, p.StudentID)
				if _, e = journey.ActivateLearningPath(ctx, p.StudentID, other.ID, c.Version, false, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			}
			before := snapshot(t, p)
			if _, _, e = actions.OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx, p.StudentID, b.TaskInstanceID, b.LearningActionID, time.Now().UTC()); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("reserved open bypasses admission: %v", e)
			}
			if _, replayed, e := actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, input); e != nil || !replayed {
				t.Fatalf("reservation receipt lost: replay=%v err=%v", replayed, e)
			}
			if before != snapshot(t, p) {
				t.Fatal("denial/replay mutated state")
			}
		})
	}
}
